name: @launchwrighthq/devbox-client
description: Run a project's verify gate in a workspace on a remote host.
//: The version must equal VERSION; tests/test-version-agreement.sh checks it.
The package name is scoped because `devbox` on npm is the Nix tool from
Jetify; the installed command is still `devbox`. No install hook: the
package writes nothing outside its own directory.
